dialogDescription: Manage the built-in provider catalog (enable/disable, ordering, available models, environment variables) — installed status is auto-filled from local detection

provider.modelsHint: Enabled models (unchecked ones won't appear in the "Create Profile" dropdown or the in-conversation "switch model" dropdown)
provider.envHint: Environment variables (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) — values are always shown masked as ***; this list only shows which keys are set and can't be read back in plaintext.

global.description: core's layered settings (defaults → <configPath/> → environment variables) — fields sourced from an env var are locked (editing the config file has no effect; env vars always win); changes require restarting core to take effect.
global.noInterfaceEditReason: Cannot be changed from this interface, to avoid expanding the remote-adjustment surface — edit the config file manually or set {{envVarName}}
global.lockedByEnvVar: Currently determined by {{envVarName}} — editing the config file has no effect
global.taskWorktreesRootPlaceholder: Omit = keep the existing default (each team's own .deskmony-worktrees next to it)
global.dataDirLockedReason: Not in the safe subset editable via the gateway — edit the config file manually or set {{envVarName}}

notification.description: Out-of-band notifications for escalations/circuit-breaker trips (read-only) — the webhook URL is treated as a credential, so no remote/UI write path is provided even over a local connection; to change these, edit the <notificationBlock/> block in <configPath/> directly and restart core for it to take effect.
notification.webhookUrlLockedReason: Treated as a credential, always masked, read-only

permission.description: The policy allowlist currently in effect (allow/deny rules for the default-deny middle ground). This list has no power over hard-deny (force-push, secret-path reads, deletes outside the worktree, non-allowlisted network connections) — those four categories remain a floor no matter what's set here; to bypass them, use the "true-unrestricted" toggle on an individual session in the chat header.
permission.remoteNotice: You're editing this list over a remote connection — once saved, it applies to every connection.
permission.toolRequired: Enter a tool name (use * for any tool)
